papers.title: CUAAudit: Meta-Evaluation of Vision-Language Models as Auditors of Autonomous Computer-Use Agents
papers.authors: Marta Sumyk, Oleksandr Kosovan
papers.intro: 本文对五个视觉语言模型（VLM）作为计算机使用代理的自动审计员进行大规模元评估，从准确性、置信度校准和模型间一致性三个维度分析其表现，发现当前模型审计方法在复杂或异构环境中性能显著下降且模型间分歧明显。

papers.title: Safe and Scalable Web Agent Learning via Recreated Websites
papers.authors: Hyungjoo Chae, Jungsoo Park, Alan Ritter
papers.affiliations: School of Interactive Computing, Georgia Institute of Technology
papers.intro: 提出VERIENV框架，通过将真实网站克隆为可执行、可验证的合成环境，并自动生成带确定性验证程序的任务，实现安全且可扩展的自主Web代理自我进化学习。

papers.title: Video-Based Reward Modeling for Computer-Use Agents
papers.authors: Linxin Song, Jieyu Zhang, Huanxin Sheng, Taiwei Shi, Gupta Rahul, Yang Liu, Ranjay Krishna, Jian Kang, Jieyu Zhao
papers.affiliations: University of Southern California, University of Washington, MBZUAI, Amazon AGI
papers.intro: 本文通过构建大规模执行视频奖励数据集ExeVR-53k并设计时空token剪枝策略，微调得到ExeVRM模型，实现了仅依赖执行视频和用户指令即可高质量评估CUA任务完成与否，在多个平台上超越了GPT-5.2等强基线模型。

papers.title: AgentOS: From Application Silos to a Natural Language-Driven Data Ecosystem
papers.authors: Rui Liu, Tao Zhe, Dongjie Wang, Zijun Yao, Kunpeng Liu, Yanjie Fu, Huan Liu, Jian Pei
papers.affiliations: University of Kansas（Rui Liu, Tao Zhe, Dongjie Wang, Zijun Yao）, Clemson University（Kunpeng Liu）, Arizona State University（Yanjie Fu, Huan Liu）, Duke University（Jian Pei）
papers.intro: 本文提出AgentOS，一种以自然语言/语音为统一入口、以Agent Kernel为核心的智能操作系统新范式，并将实现AgentOS重构为知识发现与数据挖掘（KDD）研究议程。

papers.title: OSExpert: Computer-Use Agents Learning Professional Skills via Exploration
papers.authors: Jiateng Liu, Zhenhailong Wang, Rushi Wang, Bingxuan Li, Jeonghwan Kim, Aditi Tiwari, Pengfei Yu, Denghui Zhang, Heng Ji
papers.affiliations: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, Stevens Institute of Technology
papers.intro: 本文提出OSExpert，一种无需人工标注的自主学习范式，通过GUI-DFS探索、单次前向传递规划器和技能边界检查，使代理自主获取环境技能集，在OSExpert-Eval基准上实现约20%的性能提升，并将效率差距（与人类相比）缩小约80%。

papers.title: UniPAR: A Unified Framework for Pedestrian Attribute Recognition
papers.authors: Minghe Xu, Rouying Wu, Jiarui Xu, Minhao Sun, Zikang Yan, Xiao Wang, ChiaWei Chu, Yu Li
papers.affiliations: City University of Macau; Zhuhai College of Science and Technology; Macau University of Science and Technology; Anhui University
papers.intro: UniPAR提出一个基于Transformer的统一行人属性识别框架，通过分阶段融合编码器、统一数据调度策略和动态分类头，使单个模型能够同时处理RGB图像、视频和事件流等多种异质数据，在多数据集联合训练下实现与专门SOTA相当的性能并显著提升跨域泛化能力。

papers.title: Real5-OmniDocBench: A Full-Scale Physical Reconstruction Benchmark for Robust Document Parsing in the Wild
papers.authors: Changda Zhou, Ziyue Gao, Xueqing Wang, Tingquan Gao, Cheng Cui, Jing Tang, Yi Liu
papers.affiliations: PaddlePaddle Team, Baidu Inc.; The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)
papers.intro: 本文提出Real5-OmniDocBench，通过全量一对一物理重建OmniDocBench v1.5的1,355张图片，构建扫描、弯曲、屏幕摄影、光照、偏斜五种场景，首次实现了对文档解析模型在物理世界中性能退化的因子级归因诊断。

papers.title: Beyond Caption-Based Queries for Video Moment Retrieval
papers.authors: David Pujol-Perich, Albert Clapés, Dima Damen, Sergio Escalera, Michael Wray
papers.affiliations: University of Barcelona / Computer Vision Center / University of Bristol（按作者具体归属见第十二节）
papers.intro: 本文揭示了 VMR 模型中字幕查询与搜索查询之间的语言差距和多时刻差距，并通过对 DETR 架构进行简单而有效的修改（移除自注意力、添加解码器查询 dropout）显著提升了模型在搜索查询上的泛化能力。

papers.title: Learning to Reason for Multi-Step Retrieval of Personal Context in Personalized Question Answering
papers.authors: Maryam Amirizaniani, Alireza Salemi, Hamed Zamani
papers.affiliations: University of Washington（Maryam Amirizaniani）；University of Massachusetts Amherst（Alireza Salemi, Hamed Zamani）
papers.intro: 论文提出PR2（Personalized Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning），一个基于GRPO强化学习框架的个性化问答方法，通过在推理过程中动态地执行多步检索和证据融合，学习何时、如何从用户画像中获取个性化上下文，从而显著提升个性化回答质量。

papers.title: IntentCUA: Learning Intent-level Representations for Skill Abstraction and Multi-Agent Planning in Computer-Use Agents
papers.authors: Seoyoung Lee, Seobin Yoon, Seongbeen Lee, Yoojung Chun, Dayoung Park, Doyeon Kim, Joo Yong Sim
papers.intro: IntentCUA通过多视图意图表示学习和分层技能抽象，结合多智能体协作与意图对齐的计划记忆，显著提升了长时域桌面自动化任务的执行成功率和效率（任务成功率74.83%，步效率比0.91）。

papers.title: YOLO26: A Comprehensive Architecture Overview and Key Improvements
papers.authors: Priyanto Hidayatullah, Refdinal Tubagus
papers.affiliations: aComputer Engineering and Informatics Department, Politeknik Negeri Bandung, Kab. Bandung Barat, Indonesia; bStunning Vision AI, Kota Cimahi, Indonesia
papers.intro: 本文首次系统性地绘制并解析了YOLO26的CNN架构图，详细阐述了消除Distribution Focal Loss、实现端到端NMS-Free推理、引入ProgLoss+Small-Target-Aware Label Assignment（STAL）以及使用MuSGD优化器等关键改进，宣称在CP…

papers.title: ScreenParse: Moving Beyond Sparse Grounding with Complete Screen Parsing Supervision
papers.authors: A. Said Gurbuz, Sunghwan Hong, Ahmed Nassar, Marc Pollefeys, Peter Staar
papers.affiliations: IBM Research Zurich, ETH Zurich, ETH AI Center, Microsoft Switzerland
papers.intro: 本文提出ScreenParse，一个大规模、密集标注的屏幕解析数据集（771K截图、21M元素、55个UI类别），并训练ScreenVLM轻量级视觉语言模型（316M参数），通过结构感知损失生成紧凑的ScreenTag标记，在密集解析上大幅超越大VLM，且该密集监督能迁移到现有基础VLM和检测器解析…

papers.title: Mobile-Agent-v3.5: Multi-platform Fundamental GUI Agents
papers.authors: Haiyang Xu, Xi Zhang, Haowei Liu, Junyang Wang, Zhaozai Zhu, Shengjie Zhou, Xuhao Hu, Feiyu Gao, Junjie Cao, Zihua Wang, Zhiyuan Chen, Jitong Liao, Qi Zheng, Jiahui Zeng, Ze Xu, Shuai Bai, Junyang Lin, Jingren Zhou, Ming Yan
papers.intro: 提出了GUI-Owl-1.5系列（2B/4B/8B/32B/235B），通过混合数据飞轮、统一智能体能力增强和多平台环境强化学习（MRPO），在20+ GUI基准上达到开源模型SOTA，包括OSWorld 56.5、AndroidWorld 71.6、WebArena 48.4等。

papers.title: HSD: Training-Free Acceleration for Document Parsing Vision-Language Models with Hierarchical Speculative Decoding
papers.authors: Wenhui Liao, Hongliang Li, Pengyu Xie, Xinyu Cai, Yufan Shen, Yi Xin, Qi Qin, Shenglong Ye, Tianbin Li, Ming Hu, Junjun He, Yihao Liu, Wenhai Wang, Min Dou, Bin Fu, Botian Shi, Yu Qiao, Lianwen Jin
papers.affiliations: South China University of Technology, Guangzhou, China; Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory, Shanghai, China; Shenzhen Institute of Advanced Technology, CAS, Shenzhen, China; Nanjing University, Nanjing, China
papers.intro: 提出一种名为Hierarchical Speculative Decoding (HSD)的训练无关加速框架，通过两阶段（区域级并行验证+页面级全局验证）投机解码，在保持精度的同时实现显著加速（最高7.04x）。

papers.title: How Smart Is Your GUI Agent? A Framework for the Future of Software Interaction
papers.authors: Sidong Feng, Chunyang Chen
papers.affiliations: Sidong Feng - The Chinese University of Hong Kong, China; Chunyang Chen - Technical University of Munich, Germany
papers.intro: 提出了GUI代理自主性级别（GAL）六层框架（Level 0 到 Level 5），从无自动化到完全自动化，为代理能力提供明确概念化基准，以推动可信赖的软件交互发展。

papers.title: When Actions Go Off-Task: Detecting and Correcting Misaligned Actions in Computer-Use Agents
papers.authors: Yuting Ning, Jaylen Jones, Zhehao Zhang, Chentao Ye, Weitong Ruan, Junyi Li, Rahul Gupta, Huan Sun
papers.affiliations: The Ohio State University (Yuting Ning, Jaylen Jones, Zhehao Zhang, Huan Sun); Amazon AGI (Chentao Ye, Weitong Ruan, Junyi Li, Rahul Gupta)
papers.intro: 本文首次系统定义并研究计算机使用代理中的“不对齐动作”检测问题，提出包含2264个人工标注动作的基准MisActBench和一个两阶段运行时守卫DeAction，在离线评估中F1比基线高15%以上，在线对抗场景下攻击成功率降低90%以上。

papers.title: When Benign Inputs Lead to Severe Harms: Eliciting Unsafe Unintended Behaviors of Computer-Use Agents
papers.authors: Jaylen Jones, Zhehao Zhang, Yuting Ning, Eric Fosler-Lussier, Pierre-Luc St-Charles, Yoshua Bengio, Dawn Song, Yu Su, Huan Sun
papers.affiliations: The Ohio State University, LawZero, Mila – Quebec AI Institute, Université de Montréal, UC Berkeley
papers.intro: 本文首次为计算机使用代理（CUAs）的意外不安全行为建立了统一的概念框架，并提出自动触发框架AutoElicit，通过在良性输入上施加现实且仍然良性的扰动，成功从多个前沿CUA中发现了数百个有害意外行为。

papers.title: Mapping the Design Space of User Experience for Computer Use Agents
papers.authors: Ruijia Cheng, Jenny T. Liang, Eldon Schoop, Jeffrey Nichols
papers.affiliations: Apple (Cheng, Schoop, Nichols); Carnegie Mellon University (Liang)
papers.intro: 通过回顾现有系统、访谈实践者以及Wizard-of-Oz用户实验，构建并验证了一个包含用户查询、可解释性、用户控制和心智模型四个类别的计算机使用代理用户体验设计空间分类法。

papers.title: ANCHOR: Branch-Point Data Generation for GUI Agents
papers.authors: Jinbiao Wei, Yilun Zhao, Kangqi Ni, Arman Cohan
papers.affiliations: Yale University (Jinbiao Wei, Yilun Zhao, Arman Cohan); University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill (Kangqi Ni)
papers.intro: 提出ANCHOR框架，通过从少量高质量种子演示中识别UI状态变化的分支点，派生新的状态接地任务变体，并经过执行、验证和步骤级过滤去噪，生成高多样性、高保真度的桌面GUI轨迹数据，显著提升代理性能。

papers.title: Dolphin-v2: Universal Document Parsing via Scalable Anchor Prompting
papers.authors: Hao Feng, Wei Shi, Ke Zhang, Xiang Fei, Lei Liao, Dingkang Yang, Yongkun Du, Xuecheng Wu, Jingqun Tang, Yang Liu, Hong Chen, Can Huang
papers.tags: object detection, scene understanding, image classification, OCR, gui
papers.intro: Dolphin-v2提出了一种文档类型感知的两阶段混合文档解析框架，通过联合分类与布局分析（数字文档 vs 拍照文档）以及分而治之的混合解析策略（拍照文档整体解析、数字文档基于布局锚点并行解析），在OmniDocBench上提升14.78分，拍照文档错误率降低91%。
